question.text: High portfolio turnover from frequent rebalancing tends to result in:

answer.text: Higher brokerage + STT + bid-ask spread + capital gains tax

explanation.text: The Logic: Costs accumulate: brokerage, STT, impact cost, bid-ask spread, taxes on realised gains. Moderate rebalancing beats extreme. The Trap: Turnover costs compound meaningfully over years. Cross-Exam Context: Execution economics. Manager's Pro-Tip: Annualised cost of 50 bps of turnover can easily eat 100-150 bps of annual return — worth optimising.
